# cache commands

Every `cache` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `cache:clear`

Clear application cache (e.g. var/cache/twig) and cycle running workers so they drop their in-memory templates.

```bash
bin/semitexa cache:clear
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--twig` | no |
| `--no-reload` | no |
| `--via-docker` | no |

## `cache:flush`

Flush all cache entries in a namespace.

```bash
bin/semitexa cache:flush
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--namespace` | yes |
| `--scope` | yes |

## `cache:forget`

Remove a single cache entry by key.

```bash
bin/semitexa cache:forget "<key>" ["namespace"]
```

## `cache:tags:flush`

Flush all cache entries associated with the given tags.

```bash
bin/semitexa cache:tags:flush "<tags>"
```
